messages.subject: Project Indigo - draft term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Marco, Giulia,

Following the technical sessions, please find attached our draft non-binding term sheet for the Helios licence. Headlines: exclusive in the industrial/robotics field for the EEA, UK and Switzerland; £4.5m upfront; 6% running royalty (open); £750k minimum from year 2; nine-month technology transfer. Automotive ADAS is reserved to Cobalt.

Look forward to your comments.

Kind regards,
James

James Osei | Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
